text: For the leader. A song of the Korahites. According to alamoth. [1]
I God is our refuge and our strength,an ever-present help in distress. [AA]
t[2]Thus we do not fear, though earth be shakenand mountains quake to the depths of the sea,
Though its waters rage and foamand mountains totter at its surging. [AB]Selah
II [3]Streams of the river gladden the city of God,the holy dwelling of the Most High. [AC]
God is in its midst; it shall not be shaken;God will help it at break of day. [AD]
Though nations rage and kingdoms totter,he utters his voice and the earth melts. [AE]
t[4]The Lord of hosts is with us;our stronghold is the God of Jacob.Selah
III Come and see the works of the Lord,who has done fearsome deeds on earth; [AF]
Who stops wars to the ends of the earth,breaks the bow, splinters the spear,and burns the shields with fire; [AG]
t[AH] "Be still and know that I am God!I am exalted among the nations,exalted on the earth."
The Lord of hosts is with us;our stronghold is the God of Jacob.Selah
